fields.name: company_id
fields.label: Company
fields.help: Company related to this journal

fields.name: bank_statements_source
fields.label: Bank Feeds
fields.help: Defines how the bank statements will be registered

fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.help: Set active to false to hide the Journal without removing it.

fields.name: type
fields.label: Type
fields.help:
Select 'Sale' for customer invoices journals.
        Select 'Purchase' for vendor bills journals.
        Select 'Cash', 'Bank' or 'Credit Card' for journals that are used in customer or vendor payments.
        Select 'General' for miscellaneous operations journals.

fields.name: country_code
fields.label: Country Code
fields.help:
The ISO country code in two chars. 
You can use this field for quick search.

fields.name: reconcile_aggregate
fields.label: Reconcile aggregation
fields.help: Aggregation to use on reconcile view

fields.name: suspense_account_id
fields.label: Suspense Account
fields.help: Bank statements transactions will be posted on the suspense account until the final reconciliation allowing finding the right account.

fields.name: profit_account_id
fields.label: Profit Account
fields.help: Used to register a profit when the ending balance of a cash register differs from what the system computes

fields.name: loss_account_id
fields.label: Loss Account
fields.help: Used to register a loss when the ending balance of a cash register differs from what the system computes

fields.name: refund_sequence
fields.label: Dedicated Credit Note Sequence
fields.help: Check this box if you don't want to share the same sequence for invoices and credit notes made from this journal

fields.name: payment_sequence
fields.label: Dedicated Payment Sequence
fields.help: Check this box if you don't want to share the same sequence on payments and bank transactions posted on this journal

fields.name: code
fields.label: Short Code
fields.help: Shorter name used for display. The journal entries of this journal will also be named using this prefix by default.

fields.name: currency_id
fields.label: Currency
fields.help: The currency used to enter statement

fields.name: inbound_payment_method_line_ids
fields.label: Inbound Payment Methods
fields.help:
Manual: Get paid by any method outside of Odoo.
Payment Providers: Each payment provider has its own Payment Method. Request a transaction on/to a card thanks to a payment token saved by the partner when buying or subscribing online.
Batch Deposit: Collect several customer checks at once generating

fields.name: sequence
fields.label: Sequence
fields.help: Used to order Journals in the dashboard view

fields.name: outbound_payment_method_line_ids
fields.label: Outbound Payment Methods
fields.help:
Manual: Pay by any method outside of Odoo.
Check: Pay bills by check and print it from Odoo.
SEPA Credit Transfer: Pay in the SEPA zone by submitting a SEPA Credit Transfer file to your bank. Module account_sepa is necessary.

fields.name: restrict_mode_hash_table
fields.label: Secure Posted Entries with Hash
fields.help: If ticked, when an entry is posted, we retroactively hash all moves in the sequence from the entry back to the last hashed entry. The hash can also be performed on demand by the Secure Entries wizard.

fields.name: alias_id
fields.label: Alias
fields.help:
Send one separate email for each invoice.

Any file extension will be accepted.

Only PDF and XML files will be interpreted by Odoo

fields.name: alias_name
fields.label: Alias Name
fields.help: The name of the email alias, e.g. 'jobs' if you want to catch emails for <jobs@example.odoo.com>

fields.name: invoice_reference_type
fields.label: Communication Type
fields.help: You can set here the default communication that will appear on customer invoices, once validated, to help the customer to refer to that particular invoice when making the payment.

fields.name: invoice_reference_model
fields.label: Communication Standard
fields.help: You can choose different models for each type of reference. The default one is the Odoo reference.
